fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) expects 2027 raised prices to be reflected when high-bandwidth memory (HBM) pricing resets on January 1, to be reported with December earnings.
fields.summary_ko.1: The CEO expects 2027 to be better than 2026, with supply-demand dynamics to tighten significantly in 2027–2028, and over 75% of 2027 HBM supply already contracted.
fields.summary_ko.2: Nvidia's Vera Rubin platform HBM4 chip is in mass production, and a custom HBM product co-designed with Nvidia is awaiting its first major order.
